messages:
Priya (sales): Prospect (payment processor) pressing on BYO-KMS for the pilot. They want a single-page comparison: perf delta, sample cost impact for rotation cadence, network allowlist, and short answers for their security questionnaire. Need it for legal/procurement.
Evan (platform): Quick numbers: BYO unwraps add an auth+network hop. Typical extra latency 8-35ms p50 depending on RTT and auth method. If same-region cloud KMS expect lower end.
Lena (crypto): For the questionnaire: confirm KEK is customer-controlled, DEKs are envelope keys, we can provide attestation PDFs and a hashed audit trail. Recommend DEK cache TTL default 5m, LRU cap per-tenant (suggest 500) and require cache sealing on restart.
Marco (solutions): POC plan: deliver two variants: A) Redwood-managed envelopes (baseline) and B) BYO-KMS with sidecar DEK cache. Provide a small harness and a curl/vegeta example for them to run from their infra.
Priya (sales): They asked for rotation cost impact table (daily/weekly/monthly). Can we give conservative ranges for procurement?
Evan (platform): Rule-of-thumb: monthly = baseline; weekly adds ~5-12% additional unwraps; daily can add ~30-60% depending on churn and active-key rewrap strategy. We'll call these estimates and tie to POC metrics.
Lena (crypto): If customer forbids caching, note that latency and ops cost will increase significantly. Include an emergency rotation/revocation playbook and recommended KEK rotation cadence options.
Marco (solutions): I'll attach a tiny terraform snippet for the connector and a one-page network diagram listing outbound HTTPS (443) to their KMS endpoints. If they use on-prem HSM, request IP allowlist and optional mTLS certs.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #SUP-5099 assigned Marco (solutions)  POC packet due in 72h.
Priya (sales): Action items: Marco -> perf harness + terraform + diagram; Evan -> cost-sensitivity table + latency bullets; Lena -> attestation pack + questionnaire answers. I'll package and send to procurement once ready. Thanks :thumbsup:
